summary: On paper Cincinnati has the edge (Cincinnati's defense ranks 19th in EPA per dropback, +0.05 allowed). Under center, Joe Burrow ranks 2nd of 30 in EPA per dropback and Michael Penix Jr. ranks 26th; x-factor: Drake London gets 29% of Atlanta's targets and 39% of its air yards, and Cincinnati's pass defense ranks 19th. The model favors Cincinnati at 69%, mostly on starting QB (3.8 pts) and passing matchup (2.9 pts).

CIN.detail: Cincinnati's defense ranks 19th in EPA per dropback (+0.05 allowed). Atlanta ranks 30th (-0.10).
Cincinnati's defense ranks 5th in red-zone TD rate (53% allowed). Atlanta ranks 15th (60%).
Cincinnati ranks 3rd in broken tackles per touch (6.3%). Atlanta's defense ranks 14th (10.9% missed).

ATL.detail: Atlanta ranks 30th in EPA per dropback (-0.10). Cincinnati's defense ranks 19th (+0.05 allowed).
Atlanta ranks 15th in red-zone TD rate (60%). Cincinnati's defense ranks 5th (53% allowed).
Atlanta's defense ranks 14th in broken tackles per touch (10.9% missed). Cincinnati ranks 3rd (6.3%).
